body.name: Unrestricted endpoint-\(L^2\) full-GATE risk
body.construction: \(R_2(G)=\inf_{(\mathsf D,T_*)}\sup_{y\in\mathcal M_2(G)}\mathbb E_{\mathsf D}[(T_*(G,Z,y(Z))-\tau_G(y))^2\mid G]\), with the infimum over every outcome-independent assignment law and every measurable possibly randomized estimator.
